whatsNew.summary: Set a Home city in Settings so Meeting Ask fact checks start from the right place. Includes everything in 0.5.287. Requires server 6.71.13.

sections.title: Home city for fact checks
items: Settings, in the Meeting assistant card, has a Home city field. Fact checks use it only when a question needs a starting point, like flying from here to Kansas City.
Enter a city and state, no street address. Leave it blank and Save to go back to your phone's area.

sections.title: See where fact checks start
items: After a save, the card shows the starting point COS uses. A city COS will not accept shows the reason under the field.
On a server older than 6.71.13 the field is not shown.

sections.title: Included from 0.5.287
items: Continue a saved meeting, review an answer as a follow-up in Work, and fact check public claims with supporting sources.
New Meeting Ask settings default to Sonnet. A model you already chose stays chosen.

sections.title: Stable transcription
items: This update does not enable experimental transcription or autonomous live cues.
